title: Apple to launch HomeView, a new smart home hub ...
desc: Apple will announce the HomeView, a new smart home hub powered by Siri and an A18 chip, designed to control other smart home devices. The device will come in two models, one for countertops and another for wall mounting, marking Apple's strongest push into smart home hardware after limited success with HomeKit and HomePod. Alongside HomeView, Apple plans to update its Apple TV set-top box and HomePod mini, and reveal a partnership with LG for smart home products like locks, thermostats, and doorbells. This launch signals Apple's renewed effort to gain traction in the smart home market.

title: Saudi, Iranian FMs Discuss Regional Tensions as UK, Syria Condemn Houthi Attack
desc: Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan bin Abdullah received on Sunday a phone call from his Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi. The ministers discussed the recent escalation in the region and efforts to address it. Prince Faisal also received a phone call from British Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs Ed Miliband to discuss bilateral relations, regional developments, and joint efforts by the two countries to address tensions and mitigate their security and economic repercussions.
